starting-out-talking-to-romeo.text: If the player is nearby Romeo:

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Blub! Blub...where is my Juliet? Have you seen her?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Looking for a blonde girl, goes by the name of Juliet..quite pretty...haven't seen her have you?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Juliet, Juliet, wherefore art thou Juliet? Have you seen my Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh woe is me that I cannot find my Juliet! You haven't seen Juliet have you?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Sadness surrounds me now that Juliet's father forbids us to meet. Have you seen my Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: What is to become of me and my darling Juliet, I cannot find her anywhere, have you seen her?

options.text: Yes, I have seen her actually!

steps.player: Yes, I have seen her actually!
At least, I think it was her... Blonde? A bit stressed?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Golly...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: And I'll bet she's a bit of a fox!

steps.player: Well, I guess she could be considered attractive...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: I'll bet she is!  Wooooooooo!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Sorry, all that jubilation has made me forget what we were talking about.

steps.player: You were asking me about Juliet? You seemed to know her?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yes, Juliet!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: The fox...could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?

steps.player: What?  Surely you mean that she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better!  Oh you're so good at this!

steps.player: Yes, okay. I'll let her know.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh great! And tell her that I want to kiss her a give.

steps.player: You mean you want to give her a kiss!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh you're good...you are good!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: I see I've picked a true professional...!

steps.player: Where can I find Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.player: So that I can try and find her for you!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ah yes....quite right. Hmmm, let me think now.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: She may still be locked away at her Father's house on the sest vide of Warrock.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, I remember how she loved it when I would sing up to her balcony! She would reward me with her own personal items...

steps.player: What, she just gave you her stuff?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well, not exactly give...more like 'throw with considerable force'...she's always a kidder that Juliet!

options.text: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?

steps.player: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, there is so much to tell...she is my true love, we intend to spend together forever...I can tell you so much about her..

steps.player: Great!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ermmm.....

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: So much can I tell you...

steps.player: Yes..

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: So much to tell...why, where do I start!

steps.player: Yes..yes!  Please go on...don't let me interrupt...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ermmm.....

steps.player: You can't remember can you?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Not a thing sorry....

steps.player: Ok, thanks.
Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now. Maybe later?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, okay, well, I guess my Juliet and I can spend some time apart.  And as the old saying goes, 'Absinthe makes the heart glow longer'.

steps.player: Don't you mean that, 'Absence makes the...
Actually forget it...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Okay!

options.text: No sorry, I haven't seen her.

steps.player: No sorry, I haven't seen her.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh...well, that's a shame...I was rather hoping you had.

steps.player: Why?  Is she a fugitive?  Does she owe you some money or something?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Hmmm, she might do?  Perhaps she does?  How do you know?

steps.player: I don't know? I was asking 'YOU' how 'YOU' know Juliet!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love.  Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?

steps.player: What?  Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better!  Oh you're so good at this!

options.text: Perhaps I could help to find her for you?

steps.player: Perhaps I can help find her for you? What does she look like?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh would you? That would be great! She has this sort of hair...

steps.player: Hair...check..

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: ...and she these...great lips...

steps.player: Lips...right.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh and she has these lovely shoulders as well..

steps.player: Shoulders...right, so she has hair, lips and shoulders...that should cut it down a bit.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yes, Juliet is very different...please tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?

steps.player: What?  Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better!  Oh you're so good at this!

starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.player: You haven't got a clue who I am do you?

starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.speaker: Romeo
starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.text: Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face...a little blood stained, and perhaps in need of a wash, but friendly none the less.

starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.player: You asked me to look for Juliet for you!

starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.speaker: Romeo
starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.text: Ah yes, Juliet...my sweet darling...what news?

starting-out-talking-to-romeo-again.player: Nothing so far, but I need to ask a few questions?

options.text: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?

finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc.speaker: Draul Leptoc
finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc.text: What are you doing here? Snooping around...

options.text: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.

steps.player: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: What...what...Romeo! Why that good for nothing swine...he's always trying to get the affections of my daughter..that soppy, half brained nincompoop won't ever have the heart of my daughter.

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: She deserves someone of character, wit and repose.

steps.player: What's so wrong about Romeo?

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Wrong! What's wrong with him...have you actually talked to him? He's nothing but a dim witted upperclass twit, totally useless.

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: If he threw a stone at the ground, he'd probably miss! He's totally invisible when it's raining because he's so wet!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: If you started with what's right with him, you'd have much less to consider!

steps.player: Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Sharp? I've seen keener wit in root vegetables.  Anyway, stop changing the subject. Get out of here and don't think you can sneak up those stairs to see Juliet, because I'll catch you and then you'll be for it!

steps.player: That seems a bit harsh....

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Harsh but fair I think you'll find...now get OUT!

options.text: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.

steps.player: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: What on earth about?  I hope you're not in cahoots with that good for nothing Romeo!

steps.player: Err..no of course not....why would I be?

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: He's been trying to wooo my daughter for an age. Up until now she's had the good sense to just ignore him. I just don't know what's gotten into her recently so that she would give him the time of day.

steps.player: Well, love is mysterious!  Perhaps one day someone may even learn to love you!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: What!  Someone may fall in love with me...what are you trying to insinuate?

steps.player: Err...Nothing....I guess I'd better be going now...
Oh...just looking around...

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Just looking around! This is MY house!  You might have at least 'ASKED' to view my considerably well appointed abode...but no, you've just burst in with all the elegance of a Troll at a tea party.

steps.player: I can see that you're busy ranting so I'll just nip off and investigate a bit.
Ok, thanks.

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.speaker: Phillipa
finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.text: Hi, I'm Phillipa, Juliet's cousin. I like to keep an eye on her, make sure that dashing young Romeo doesn't just steal her away under our plain old noses!

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.speaker: Phillipa
finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.text: He'd do it, you know - he's ever so dashing, and cavalier, in a wet blanket sort of way.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.player: Juliet, I come from Romeo.  He begs me to tell you that he cares still.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.text: Oh how my heart soars to hear this news! Please take this message to him with great haste.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.player: Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.text: He's quite often upset...the poor sensitive soul. But I don't think he's going to take this news very well, however, all is not lost.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.text: Everything is explained in the letter, would you be so kind and deliver it to him please?

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.player: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet.text: Many thanks! Oh, I'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet-again.speaker: Juliet
finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet-again.text: Hello there...have you delivered the message to Romeo yet? What news do you have from my loved one?
If the player still has the message:

steps.player: Oh, sorry, I've not had chance to deliver it yet!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Oh, that's a shame. I've been waiting so patiently to hear some word from him.

finding-juliet-talking-to-juliet-again.text: If the player lost the message:

steps.player: Hmmm, that's the thing about messages...they're so easy to misplace...

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: How could you lose that message? It was incredibly important...and it took me an age to write! I used joined up writing and everything!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Please, take this new message to him, and please don't lose it.
Juliet gives you another message.

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.speaker: Phillipa
finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.text: Oh, hello. Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo, and I have to say I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.speaker: Phillipa
finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.text: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud - hysterically you might say.

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.speaker: Phillipa
finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.text: He always brings a tear to my eyes - tears of happiness at his foolish antics!

finding-juliet-talking-to-phillipa-after.player: Oh, thanks. I like to do my cupid bit.

finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.speaker: Draul Leptoc
finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.text: What are you doing in my house? Up to no good I shouldn't wonder!

finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.player: Just a small chore for Juliet, you do have a lovely daughter in her sir.

finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.speaker: Draul Leptoc
finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.text: Oh...why, thank you...I've always tried to my best...

finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.speaker: Draul Leptoc
finding-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc-a.text: ...Hang on! Enough of that smiley talk. I have a daughter and I know what she's like. Don't even think of carrying on anything behind my back, I have the eyes of a hawk, nothing gets past me!
If the player has the message on them:

steps.text: Sir Draul notices the message!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Hey! What's that in your hands...looks like a message to me...with Juliet's barely legible scrawl on it...

steps.player: Yes, yes, that's probably why I can't read it!
Sorry, I mean, that's right sir. I'm just popping to the shops to get some groceries for Juliet.
Right, have to be off now...thanks...

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Groceries!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Groceries!...at a time like this, does that girl know what she's putting me through!

delivering-the-message-talking-to-romeo.text: If the player does not have Juliet's message in their inventory:

steps.player: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh great! That is great news! Well done...well done... what a total success!

steps.player: Yes, and she gave me a message to give you...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ohhh great! A message....wow!

steps.player: Yes!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: A message...oh, I can't wait to read what my dear Juliet has to say....

steps.player: I know...it's exciting isn't it...?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Yes...yes...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: You've lost the message haven't you?

steps.player: Yep, haven't got a clue where it is.

delivering-the-message-talking-to-romeo.text: If the player has Juliet's message in their inventory:

steps.player: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet! She's written a message for you...

steps.text: You hand over Juliet's message to Romeo.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, a message! A message! I've never had a message before...

steps.player: Really?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: No, no, not one!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, well, except for the occasional court summons.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: But they're not really 'nice' messages. Not like this one! I'm sure that this message will be lovely.

steps.player: Well are you going to open it or not?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yes, yes, of course!  'Dearest Romeo, I am very pleased that you sent [player name] to look for me and to tell me that you still hold affliction...', Affliction! She thinks I'm diseased?

steps.player: 'Affection?'

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'

steps.player: Oh dear...that doesn't sound too good.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: What? '...great affection for you. Father opposes our..

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: '...marriage and will...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: ...will kill you if he sees you again!'

steps.player: I have to be honest, it's not getting any better...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: 'Our only hope is that Father Lawrence, our long time confidant, can help us in some way.'
Romeo folds the message away.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...

steps.player: What about Father Lawrence?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: ...our love is over...the great romance, the life of my love...

steps.player: ...or you could speak to Father Lawrence!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, my aching, breaking, heart...how useless the situation is now...we have no one to turn to...

steps.player: FATHER LAWRENCE!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Father Lawrence?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh yes, Father Lawrence...he's our long time confidant, he might have a solution! Yes, yes, you have to go and talk to Lather Fawrence for us and ask him if he's got any suggestions for our predicament?

steps.player: Where can I find Father Lawrence?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?

steps.player: I think I suspected that he wasn't.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.

steps.player: How are you?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Joopie...

steps.player: Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly!

steps.player: Hmmm, so I see!

options.text: Where can I find Father Lawrence?

steps.player: Where can I find Father Lawrence?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?

steps.player: I think I suspected that he wasn't.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.

options.text: Have you heard anything from Juliet?

steps.player: Have you heard anything from Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatened to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!

steps.player: Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: I just wish I could remember what he looks like! I live in fear of every man I see!

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

delivering-the-message-using-a-duplicate.speaker: Romeo
delivering-the-message-using-a-duplicate.text: Why are you waving that around at me as if it's something important?

options.text: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
Have you heard anything from Juliet?

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.player: Hi Juliet, I have passed your message on to Romeo..he's scared half out of his wits at the news that your father wants to kill him.

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.text: Yes, unfortunately my father is quite the hunter, you may have seen some the animal head trophies on the wall. And it would be so awful to see Romeo's head up there with them!

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.player: ...his hair colour will clash terribly with the rest of the decoration.

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.text: That's not what I was suggesting at all...

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.player: I know, I know...I was just kidding.
Anyway, don't worry because I'm on the case. I'm going to get some help from Father Lawrence.

delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
delivering-the-message-talking-to-juliet.text: Oh yes, I'm sure that Father Lawrence will come up with a solution. I hope you find him soon.

delivering-the-message-talking-to-draul-.speaker: Draul Leptoc
delivering-the-message-talking-to-draul-.text: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be like that freeloading Romeo!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: ''...and let Saradomin light the way for you... '' Urgh!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: Can't you see that I'm in the middle of a Sermon?!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: But I'm busy delivering a sermon to my congregation!
The camera pans around to face his sleeping congregation.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Yes, well, it certainly seems like you have a captive audience!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: Ok, ok...what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Romeo sent me. He says you may be able to help.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: Ah Romeo, yes. A fine lad, but a little bit confused.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Yes, very confused....Anyway, Romeo wishes to be married to Juliet! She must be rescued from her father's control!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: I agree, and I think I have an idea! A potion to make her appear dead...

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Dead! Sounds a bit creepy to me...but please, continue.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: The potion will only make Juliet 'appear' dead...then she'll be taken to the crypt...

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Crypt! Again...very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.speaker: Father Lawrence
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothecary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.player: Apart from the strong overtones of death, this is turning out to be a real love story.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-fathe.text: If the player has not made a cadava potion:

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: Ah, have you found the Apothecary yet? Remember, Cadava potion, for Juliet.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Romeo
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-romeo.text: Ooh did you manage to survive one of Lather Fawrences sermons? I bet not, you were ages! I bet you snoozed on the welcome mat just as soon as you heard his voice!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Romeo
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-romeo.text: Oh, come on, come on, what did he say?

options.text: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!

steps.player: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: The Apothecary?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh...is he the one who mixes up all them magical potion- ey things?

steps.player: Yeah, I think so...but the word potion-ey doesn't exist.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!

steps.player: It doesn't matter...do you know where the Apothecary is?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Why should I tell you?

steps.player: Because I'm doing you a favour!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Right, yes...of course! Well, I think the potion-ey place is Wouth Sest of here and near a sword shop.

options.text: He seems keen for you to marry Juliet.

steps.player: He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Me too! I can't wait! Do you think it will be soon?

steps.player: I don't know, but I'll do what I can. It just seems a bit odd that Father Lawrence is so keen for you to marry?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: I can't imagine why he's so keen? Though, he was our messenger before you. Of course, he had a lot more hair back then...and I think we may have gone to school together...

steps.player: What, since you were kids?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Yeah! Thinking about it now, we called him 'Diddy Dorrence' back then!

steps.player: So, maybe, he just wants a bit of peace? And when you two are married, he won't have to traipse around delivering your messages anymore?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Yes, the years haven't been good to him.

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-julie.player: Hi Juliet, I've found Father Lawrence and he has a cunning plan. But for it to work, I need to seek the Apothecary!

finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-julie.speaker: Juliet
finding-father-lawrence-talking-to-julie.text: Oh good! I knew Father Lawrence would come up with something. However, I don't know where the apothecary is...I hope you find him soon. My father's temper gets no better.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.speaker: Apothecary
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

options.text: Can you make potions for me?

steps.player: Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
If the player has cadava berries in their inventory:

steps.player: Conveniently, I have some here.

steps.text: You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Phew! Here is what you need.
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
If the player does not have cadava berries in their inventory:

options.text: What do these berries look like?

steps.player: What do these berries look like?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.

options.text: Where can I get these berries?

steps.player: Where can I get these berries?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!

steps.player: How are these berries dangerous?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!

steps.player: Ok, thanks.

options.text: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
Have you got any good potions to give away?

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.speaker: Apothecary
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

options.text: Can you make potions for me?

steps.text: Without any cadava berries:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Keep searching for those Cadavaberries. They're needed for the potion.
With some cadava berries:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Well done. You have the berries.
You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
The apothercary mixes the potion, creating a burst of smoke.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Phew! Here is what you need.
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
With the cadava potion:

steps.player: Thank you for the Cadava potion.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You're welcome. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
After giving Juliet the cadava potion:

steps.player: I gave Juliet the Cadava potion.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Good, good. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.

options.text: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
Have you got any good potions to give away?

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.text: This looks very colourful, but you remember what Father Lawrence told you about it, probably best not to drink it.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.prompt: Are you sure you wish to drink this Cadava Potion?

options.text: Yes, I'll drink it all down.

steps.text: In defiance of Father Lawrence's warnings, you drink the entire contents of the potion.
The screen starts swaying.

steps.player: Urk!

steps.text: Oh dear...you are nearly dead.
Some time later.....

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Blimey... you've been out for hours! Are you ok? People were tripping over you as they walked into the shop.

options.text: No, I'm having second thoughts now.

steps.text: You decide against drinking the potion.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-the-.text: You dare not drink this outside of the apothecary's establishment. At least there the apothecary may be able to help you if you need assistance.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-fath.text: If player is not carrying a cadava potion:

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: Did you find the Apothecary?

steps.player: Yes I did. He's told me I must find some Cadava berries.

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: Well, good luck with that...they're quite tricky to find.

steps.player: Any clues where I can start to look?

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: I heard some kids saying they saw some the other day. They were visiting the mining place to the south east of Varrock.

steps.player: Ok, that's as good a place to start looking as any.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-fath.text: If player is carrying a cadava potion:

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: Did you find the Apothecary?

steps.player: I've got the cadava potion.

steps.speaker: Father Lawrence
steps.text: Good! Good work! Ok, take it to Juliet, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-rome.text: If player is not carrying a cadava potion:

steps.player: Hi Romeo!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh hello, have you seen Lather Fawrence?

steps.player: Yes, he's given me details of a potion which should help resolve this situation. The Apothecary is helping me prepare it.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ooooh, it all sounds horribly complicated?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: All I can say is I'll be glad when Juliet's finally in that crypt!

steps.player: Spoken like a true lover!

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-rome.text: If player is carrying a cadava potion:

steps.text: Romeo spots the Cadava potion.

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Ooohh, that's the potion is it? Rather you than me!

steps.player: I'm not drinking it! It's for Juliet!

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.

steps.player: Hmm, I'm not convinced...maybe you ought to try some before I give it to Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Urgh! No way!  Not in a million years!

steps.player: Ok...but you know what to do when I've given this to Juliet?

steps.speaker: Romeo
steps.text: Oh, yeah...sure Lather Fawrence explained all that to me...

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.speaker: Draul Leptoc
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.text: Hey , what are you doing here?

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.player: Nothing much sir...I promise...I'm just an innocent friend of Juliet's...doing her a few favours...as a friend.

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.speaker: Draul Leptoc
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.text: Well, just make sure there's no funny business going on that's all I can say. Do you know why?

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.player: I think I can guess sir...

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.speaker: Draul Leptoc
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.text: There's no need to guess! You can see it in my hawk like eyes, in my cat like ears and my dog like nose...

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.player: Are you saying that you look like an animal sir?

making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.speaker: Draul Leptoc
making-the-cadava-potion-talking-to-drau.text: NO! Not look like an animal! I have the keen 'SENSES' of an animal and I don't miss a thing. Don't even think about trying anything!
If the player currently has the cadava potion:

steps.text: Draul notices the potion!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Hey!  What's that in your hands? Looks like some sort of potion to me!

steps.player: Err...no! Nope! Not a potion!  Some medicine...I have a terrible cough  ...cough...cough....see?
>Except, I can't drink too much or else it makes me feel 'really' tired. One sip of this and the lights go out...I mean, I'm asleep in a minute.

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Sleep!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Sleep...! How can you even think of such a thing at a time like this? And I hope you have no intentions of sleeping in my house!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: You'll get a bill for rent if I catch you dozing off around here!

delivering-the-potion-talking-to-juliet.text: If the player doesn't have a Cadava potion in their inventory:

steps.player: Hi Juliet!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Hi [player name], how close am I to being with my true love Romeo?

steps.player: Sorry, I still have to get a special potion for you.

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Oh, I hope it isn't a love potion because you would be wasting your time. My love for Romeo grows stronger every minute...

steps.player: That must be because you're not with him...

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Oh no! I long to be close to my true love Romeo!

steps.player: Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Fair luck to you, the end is close.

delivering-the-potion-talking-to-juliet.text: If the player has a Cadava potion in their inventory:

steps.player: Hi Juliet! I have an interesting proposition for you...suggested by Father Lawrence. It may be the only way you'll be able to escape from this house and be with Romeo.

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Go on....

steps.player: I have a Cadava potion here, suggested by Father Lawrence. If you drink it, it will make you appear dead!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Yes...

steps.player: And when you appear dead...your still and lifeless corpse will be removed to the crypt!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Oooooh, a cold dark creepy crypt...

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: ...sounds just peachy!

steps.player: Then...Romeo can steal into the crypt and rescue you just as you wake up!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: ...and this is the great idea for getting me out of here?

steps.player: To be fair, I can't take all the credit...in fact...it was all Father Lawrence's suggestion...

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Ok...if this is the best we can do...hand over the potion!
You pass the suspicious potion to Juliet.

delivering-the-potion-talking-to-juliet.speaker: Juliet
delivering-the-potion-talking-to-juliet.text: Wonderful! I just hope Romeo can remember to get me from the crypt.

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Please go to Romeo and make sure he understands. Although I love his gormless, lovelorn soppy ways, he can be a bit dense sometimes and I don't want to wake up in that crypt on my own.
A cutscene starts.

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Oh, here's Phillipa, my cousin...she's in on the plot too!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: She's going to make it seem even more convincing!

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Yes, I'm quite the actress! Good luck dear cousin!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Right...bottoms up!

steps.speaker: Juliet
steps.text: Urk!

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Oh no...Juliet has...died!

steps.player: You might be more believable if you're not smiling when you say it...

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Oh yeah...you might be right...ok, let's try again.

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Oh no...Juliet has...died?

steps.player: Perhaps a bit louder, like you're upset...that your cousin has died!

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Right...yes...Ok, ok, I think I'm getting my motivation now. Ok, let's try this again!

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Oooooohhhhhh....(sob), (sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: What's all that screaming?

steps.speaker: Draul Leptoc
steps.text: Oh no! My poor daughter...what has become of you?

steps.speaker: Phillipa
steps.text: Poor Juliet...make preparations for her body to be placed in the Crypt...

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.speaker: Phillipa
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.text: Oh, hello again! How was I - do you think I was convincing?

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.speaker: Phillipa
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.text: Ohhh good! I do hope Juliet will be pleased as well! That dashing young Romeo must be beside himself with excitement! Have you told him the good news yet?

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.speaker: Phillipa
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-phillipa.text: Good, good - you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc.speaker: Draul Leptoc
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-draul-leptoc.text: My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.player: Romeo, it's all set. Juliet has drunk the potion and has been taken down into the Crypt...now you just need to pop along and collect her.

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Romeo
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.text: What potion would that be then?

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.player: The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Romeo
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.text: But I'm scared...will you come with me?

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.player: Oh, ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
We're here. Look, Juliet is over there!
You go over to her...and I'll go and wait over here...

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Romeo
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.text: Oh dear...you seem to be dead.

rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.speaker: Phillipa
rescuing-juliet-talking-to-romeo.text: It's a shame about Juliet...but perhaps we can meet up later?
